claims.object_text: cross-dataset consistency from HC to CSVD-NC to CSVD-CI; distinct expression patterns between CSVD-CI and AD-CI
claims.quote: Three plasma EV proteins (ATP6V1F, HNRNPU, and RPL38) demonstrated robust, cross-dataset consistency from HC to CSVD-NC to CSVD-CI continuum, and displayed distinct expression patterns between CSVD-CI and AD-CI (P < 0.001).
EV HNRNPU with visuospatial function and executive function.
